title: Random Cap: Optimal Informationally Robust Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Are simple delegation rules optimal under ambiguity? We study delegation when the principal knows the mean, but not the distribution, of the agent's private information. In a quadratic constant-bias environment, the robustly optimal randomized mechanism is a random cap: the principal draws and reveals an upper bound below which the agent chooses freely. Randomization strictly outperforms every deterministic cap by hedging against cap-specific worst-case distributions. We characterize random caps through nondecreasing and concave expected-action rules and construct the solution using a saddle-point approach. The worst-case distribution features an exponential survival function over its continuous region and an atom at the upper endpoint. Under regularity conditions, the result extends to convex-order ambiguity. When the mean is below the agent's bias, the optimal mechanism additionally requires an incentive-neutral outcome lottery.

translated_title: 随机上限：最优信息稳健型委托
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19846v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在模糊性下，简单的委托规则是否最优？我们研究了当委托人知道代理人私人信息的均值但不知道其分布时的委托问题。在二次常数偏差环境中，稳健最优的随机机制是一个随机上限：委托人抽取并揭示一个上限，代理人可以在该上限以下自由选择。随机化通过针对特定上限的最坏情况分布进行对冲，严格优于任何确定性上限。我们通过非递减且凹的期望行动规则来刻画随机上限，并使用鞍点方法构造解。最坏情况分布在连续区域具有指数生存函数，并在上端点处有一个原子。在正则条件下，结果扩展到凸序模糊性。当均值低于代理人偏差时，最优机制还额外需要一个激励中性的结果抽签。
tldr: 本文提出在均值已知但分布未知的委托问题中，随机上限机制通过对冲最坏情况分布，严格优于确定性上限，并刻画了其最优性及扩展条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in delegation under ambiguity with known mean, a random cap mechanism strictly outperforms deterministic caps by hedging against worst-case distributions, and characterizes its optimality with extensions to convex-order ambiguity.
